Workflows:
- Remote source: ghSearch → ghGetFileContent; start at ghGetFileContent when path and ref are known.
- History: ghSearchHistory → ghGetHistoryItem; start at ghGetHistoryItem when number or ref is known.
- Changed behavior: ghGetHistoryItem for history context and diffs → ghGetFileContent for exact source at the relevant ref.
- Package source: artifactSearch → ghSearch → ghGetFileContent; skip repository discovery when the source path is known.
- Repeated remote analysis: ghCloneRepo → localSearch / astSearch / localFetch / lspSearch at the returned localPath.
- Known text: localSearch → localFetch; use regex:"literal" for exact text.
- Declaration or syntax: astSearch → localFetch; symbols with name returns declaration ranges, match finds syntax. Convert zero-based ranges to one-based lines.
- Semantic identity or use: lspSearch with an observed URI and source anchor; use localFetch only when that anchor is missing.
